title: Latency Keep At Least
prompt: A latency report should hide small latency measurements. Write a function that returns a new array containing only values greater than or equal to the minimum.

explanation.beginner:
Example: latencyKeepAtLeast([120,80,250,40], 100) produces [120,250]. Evaluate the selection rule for every record and preserve the qualifying values in the required order.

Compare “handles empty input”: input [[],100] produces []. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
explanation.junior:
